If you're in the Duluth, GA area, here are some highly rated tire shops nearby:

  1. Discount Tire (Steve Reynolds Blvd, Duluth)

    • Great for new tires, free flat repairs (even for many non-customers), rotations, balancing, and TPMS checks.

    • Well-known for competitive pricing and strong manufacturer warranties.

  2. D&C Tires Auto Service (Satellite Blvd, Duluth)

    • 5.0★ with excellent reviews for honest service and fair pricing.

    • Good choice if you want both tire service and general auto repair.

  3. Tirestar Norcross Goodyear (Jimmy Carter Blvd, Norcross)

    • 5.0★ with over 100 reviews.

    • Offers tires, alignments, brake service, and same-day repairs.

  4. Deep Tread, LLC (Buford)

    • Excellent if you're looking for both new and quality used tires.

    • Especially popular with performance and custom wheel owners.

  5. Global Tires (Lilburn)

    • Highly rated for alignments and value.

    • Great option if you also need suspension or steering work.

Services

The store sells new tires and wheels and performs professional mounting, balancing, rotations, tire repairs, and TPMS-related services. It also offers several complimentary services, including air pressure checks, tire inspections, and flat tire repairs in most cases—even for some tires not originally purchased there. Online appointment scheduling and walk-in service are both available. Discount Tire+1

What it's like

  • The location features multiple service bays, a clean showroom, complimentary Wi-Fi, and a waiting area where customers can watch technicians work.

  • Its setting on Steve Reynolds Boulevard places it within walking distance of nearby shopping and dining options, making it convenient for customers who prefer to leave the vehicle during service. Discount Tire

Good to know

  • Appointments can significantly reduce wait times, though walk-ins are welcomed. Discount Tire+1

  • The store is EV-qualified for tire installation and related services. Tire Rack
